name: ranaroussi/yfinance

score_rationale: Canonical open-source Yahoo Finance downloader with broad use for historical price ingestion and research workflows.

name: pydata/pandas-datareader
description: Extract data from a wide range of Internet sources into a pandas DataFrame.
score_rationale: Widely used historical data access layer that pulls market and macro data from multiple sources into pandas.

name: mypmc/marketstore

name: MarketDataApp/sdk-go
